fields.yahooXRank: Yahoo displayed player order; availability input only, never model value.
fields.yahooAdp: Yahoo average draft position; retained separately from XRank.
fields.aggregateRank: Mean of captured expert ranks; comparison evidence only.
fields.sourceRanks: Captured individual expert-source ranks; comparison evidence only.
fields.rankSpread: Expert disagreement; widens uncertainty without directional movement.
fields.sourceCount: Number of expert ranks represented in Aggregate Rank.
